excerpts: [Patrick Mahomes](http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3139477/patrick-mahomes) threw five touchdown passes, including one to newly acquired [](https://x.com/Chiefs/status/2122048070552559941/video/1) [Josh Downs](http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4688813/josh-downs) and two to rookie [Emmett Johnson](http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4832955/emmett-johnson) , and the Chiefs beat the struggling [Atlanta Falcons](http://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/atl/atlanta-falcons) 35-13 on Sunday to move into a first-place tie in the AFC West. In addition to Downs playing in his first game with Kansas City, Johnson was making his first start. ... “There were some guys that stepped in and really helped us out today,” said Chiefs coach Andy Reid. “For these young guys, they’re getting better. We’re one of the youngest teams in the league, and they’re getting better every week.” The Chiefs (7-2) leaned on Johnson at running back after ruling out [Kenneth Walker](https://apnews.com/article/chiefs-kenneth-walker-injury-ed605a71b982f0dba42e3230a1c4cc2d?utm--source=copy&utm--medium=share) on Saturday because of a groin injury. Johnson had 22 carries for 101 yards and six catches for 70 yards and two touchdowns. The Chiefs moved into a first-place tie with Denver, which had its bye week.
The Falcons (3-7) have lost three straight and five of six.
